qualification: scoped page-4 external X2:4/C31/C32/H2 read after model exposure; not an independent full-page netlist or internal T3 winding proof

views.description: 1200 dpi lower X2 and C31/C32 crop

1200 dpi H2 and X5:5 edge label

reading_notes: The printed X2:4 terminal leaves the lower T3 drive section and shares a line with one plate of each parallel C31/C32 capacitor.
The other C31/C32 plates join the H2 wire leaving the horizontal board at X5:5. The 600 and 1200 dpi views show this wire crossing the 00 rail without a junction; it is not grounded at that crossing.
This identifies the external capacitive return through H2, not the voltage of X2:4, the H2/yoke operating waveform, or other internal T3 tap continuities.
T3 X2:4 on the horizontal-output sheet is distinct from vertical-board connector X2:4 on the yoke assembly.
unresolved: The full page-4 pin netlist, T3 internal drive tap graph and HV cold-end return remain unqualified.
The H2/yoke waveform, C31/C32 loading and X2:4 flyback voltage still need a source-bounded operating point.
